$meta.note: English is the canonical language: the server sends English log text; the client parses it back into {key, params} and re-renders it with the locale catalog (fr/ko/zh-CN chunks 0r12sly2zwo8g.js, 0p4ahzekegpbg.js, 1wtthi75czt6u.js plus card-text chunks). Templates below use {param}=simple param, {param:selectName}=ICU select; select option sets are listed per key in $selects.
$meta.pluralization: Trailing s? in templates marks optional English plural (e.g. card(s), cards?, runes?) matching the parser regexes.
$meta.structured: sentence.payment / sentence.runeBatch / sentence.rolls are multi-part entries composed via phrase/list sub-messages.
$meta.phraseNote: phrase.* / list.* ICU catalogs (runeBatch, paymentDetails, runes, resources, floatingResources, token, team, roll, list joiners) live server-side; only fr/ko/zh-CN copies ship in the bundles. English output is the literal text produced by the server.

$structured.sentence.payment: parts: {resources}=phrase.resources/floatingResources (kind select both/energy/other), {details}=phrase.paymentDetails joined via list.paymentDetails; each detail = phrase.paymentDetail.{float|exhaust|recycle|countedCard|gold|card}
$structured.sentence.rolls: {rolls}=list.rolls of phrase.roll [{competitor} rolled {roll}.], used by sentence.rolledD20By / teamInitiativeSetup variants
$structured.parser: 0aed5y6vhcy22.js parses each English log line back into {key,params}: runeBatch via /^(channeled|exhausted|readied|recycled) ...$/ clauses; payment via /^(auto-)?paid (NE|nP|n energy…)[ — details].$/; rolls via repeated /(.+?) rolled (d+)./
